description: This file contains utility functions for managing Azure Queue streams within the Orleans framework, including generating queue names, deleting queues, and clearing messages for testing purposes.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing Azure Queue streams, including queue name generation, deletion, and clearing messages.

methods.name: GenerateDefaultAzureQueueNames
methods.description: Generates default Azure Queue names based on service ID and provider name.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedAzureQueues
methods.description: Deletes all specified Azure queues, with overloads for connection string or options.

methods.name: ClearAllUsedAzureQueues
methods.description: Clears all messages in specified Azure queues, with overloads for connection string or options.
